title: reminder.policy-changed.v1
description: BLOCKER-B (reminder-delivery-pipeline.md #4/#5, Codex Round H APPROVED 9.2/10): published via the transactional outbox on every ReminderPolicy write (create/update/disable) - a pure invalidation signal (never authoritative state, see #7) that wakes the reminder-materialization-trigger worker to re-read the policy and reconcile the occurrences it owns. `itemId` is present iff the policy's CURRENT scope is ITEM (omitted for TEMPLATE or when scope just left ITEM). `previousItemId` is present ONLY when an update moves an ITEM-scoped policy to a different item, or changes its scope away from ITEM - it exists purely so the worker can additionally reconcile the OLD item's partition (there is no global policy->occurrence index), and is never used to gate a decision, only to address a second partition to re-check (#7's fencing: any cancellation there is itself atomically conditioned on a fresh policy read, not on this field's value).
